title: SolClaw Agent Payments
summary: Let AI agents pay each other by name from token vaults, with daily caps, allowances, invoices and subscriptions.
what: SolClaw is an Anchor 0.32.1 payment layer for agents. Each agent name has a registry PDA and a token vault PDA; payments, allowances, invoices and subscriptions all move tokens between those vaults.
app_note: The page at /dapps/solclaw/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/solclaw. The lab changed declare_id and pointed USDC_MINT at the Sol.College devnet lab mint.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/solclaw/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call register_agent with a new name (usdc_mint BJMSdujxakjx7qypwfaFCnbkMTNPEYVWTTqnR9eJRL4D).
try_steps.see: A registry and vault PDA for your name.
try_steps.ran: The full payment, allowance, invoice and subscription flow (see steps).

diagram: authority --register_agent(name)--> registry+vault; --deposit--> vault; alice --transfer_by_name--> bob vault; alice --approve--> allowance; bob --transfer_from--> pull; bob --create_invoice--> alice --pay_invoice; anyone --execute_subscription--> periodic pay
innovation: Agents address each other by human-readable names, and recurring payments run without the payer online because anyone can crank a due subscription.
exercises: Why does transfer_from still apply the owner’s daily cap?
What stops a cranker from executing a subscription early?
